question.worked_solution:
Applying the average value formula, we find that the average value of the function is

$$
\begin{aligned}{g}_{\text{avg}} & =\frac{1}{b-a}{\int }_{a}^{b}g(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{\frac{\pi }{6}-0}{\int }_{0}^{\pi /6}(4\operatorname{cos}⁡5x+2\operatorname{cos}⁡3x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{6}{\pi }{\int }_{0}^{\pi /6}(4\operatorname{cos}⁡5x+2\operatorname{cos}⁡3x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\frac{6}{\pi }(\frac{4}{5}\operatorname{sin}⁡5x+\frac{2}{3}\operatorname{sin}⁡3x)|}_{0}^{\pi /6} \\  & =\frac{6}{\pi }[(\frac{4}{5}\operatorname{sin}⁡(5\cdot \frac{\pi }{6})+\frac{2}{3}\operatorname{sin}⁡(3\cdot \frac{\pi }{6}))-(\frac{4}{5}\operatorname{sin}⁡(5\cdot 0)+\frac{2}{3}\operatorname{sin}⁡(3\cdot 0))] \\  & =\frac{6}{\pi }[(\frac{4}{5}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{6})+\frac{2}{3}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2}))-(0+0)] \\  & =\frac{6}{\pi }[(\frac{4}{5}\cdot \frac{1}{2}+\frac{2}{3}\cdot 1)-0] \\  & =\frac{6}{\pi }(\frac{2}{5}+\frac{2}{3}) \\  & =\frac{6}{\pi }\cdot \frac{16}{15} \\  & =\frac{32}{5\pi }.\end{aligned}
$$
